name: Protein by UniProt ID
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein {uniprot_id: 'P04637'}) RETURN p.name, p.gene_name, p.organism

name: Protein by gene name
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein {gene_name: 'TP53'}) RETURN p.uniprot_id, p.name, p.organism

name: Human proteins count
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.organism CONTAINS 'Homo sapiens' RETURN count(p) AS human_proteins

name: Proteins per organism top 10
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:FROM_ORGANISM]->(o:Organism) RETURN o.name, count(p) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

name: GO terms for a protein
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein {gene_name: 'BRCA1'})-[:HAS_GO_TERM]->(g:GOTerm) RETURN g.go_id LIMIT 20

name: Proteins with specific GO term
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HAS_GO_TERM]->(g:GOTerm {go_id: 'GO:0006915'}) RETURN p.uniprot_id, p.name LIMIT 20

name: Longest proteins
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.sequence_length > 5000 RETURN p.uniprot_id, p.name, p.sequence_length ORDER BY p.sequence_length DESC LIMIT 10

name: Proteins with EC number
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.ec_number CONTAINS '.' RETURN count(p) AS enzyme_count

name: Organism diversity
cypher: MATCH (o:Organism) RETURN count(o) AS organism_count

name: GO term distribution
cypher: MATCH (g:GOTerm)<-[:HAS_GO_TERM]-(p:Protein) RETURN g.go_id, count(p) AS proteins ORDER BY proteins DESC LIMIT 15

name: Multi-gene proteins
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.gene_names CONTAINS ' ' RETURN p.uniprot_id, p.gene_name, p.gene_names LIMIT 10

name: Proteins by entry name pattern
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.entry_name CONTAINS '_HUMAN' RETURN count(p) AS human_entries

name: Kinase proteins
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.name CONTAINS 'kinase' RETURN p.uniprot_id, p.gene_name, p.name LIMIT 15

name: Receptor proteins
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.name CONTAINS 'receptor' RETURN p.uniprot_id, p.gene_name LIMIT 15

name: Cross-KG protein to drug gene bridge
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein {gene_name: 'DRD2'}) WITH p MATCH (g:Gene {gene_name: 'DRD2'}) RETURN p.uniprot_id, p.name, g.gene_name

name: Proteins in Parkinson pathways
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HAS_GO_TERM]->(g:GOTerm) WHERE g.go_id = 'GO:0007212' RETURN p.uniprot_id, p.gene_name LIMIT 10

name: Total protein node count
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein) RETURN count(p) AS total_proteins

name: Total GO term count
cypher: MATCH (g:GOTerm) RETURN count(g) AS total_go_terms

name: Protein with most GO terms
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HAS_GO_TERM]->(g:GOTerm) WITH p, count(g) AS go_count ORDER BY go_count DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN p.uniprot_id, p.gene_name, go_count

name: Average GO terms per protein
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HAS_GO_TERM]->(g:GOTerm) WITH p, count(g) AS gc RETURN avg(gc) AS avg_go_terms

name: Proteins shared between organisms
cypher: MATCH (o:Organism)<-[:FROM_ORGANISM]-(p:Protein) WHERE o.name CONTAINS 'Escherichia coli' RETURN count(p) AS ecoli_proteins

name: Oxidoreductase enzymes
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.ec_number STARTS WITH '1.' RETURN p.uniprot_id, p.name, p.ec_number LIMIT 10

name: Transferase enzymes
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.ec_number STARTS WITH '2.' RETURN p.uniprot_id, p.name, p.ec_number LIMIT 10

name: Hydrolase enzymes
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.ec_number STARTS WITH '3.' RETURN p.uniprot_id, p.name, p.ec_number LIMIT 10

name: Alpha-synuclein protein
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.gene_name = 'SNCA' RETURN p.uniprot_id, p.name, p.organism, p.sequence_length
